commits_data.message:
WIP: TLS: Add glob pattern for keylog files

Add glob pattern support in Preferences -> Protocols -> TLS for multiple key log files. This mode is enabled when the last component of the filename contains either '*' or '?'. Unlike in single log file mode, this mode does not support growing log file(s). Closes #19069.
